films.title: FTS
films.description: Federal Bikes' 2019 NORA Cup-winning full-length follows the team through two years of street filming around the world. Filmed and edited by Rich Forne, the 49-minute film features Bruno Hoffmann, Ryan Eles, Michal Smelko, James Cunningham, Joe Jarvis, Anthony Perrin, and Dan Lacey across London, Seville, Philadelphia, California, Barcelona, Tel Aviv, and Madrid.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Federal Bikes' official channel; exact runtime 48:57. The description identifies FTS as the brand's complete NORA Cup-winning full-length and credits the worldwide production to Rich Forne and the Federal team.
Federal Bikes' first-party release page presents FTS in its entirety, identifies it as a worldwide full-length, and credits Rich Forne for filming and editing.
Ride UK BMX's July 2019 review confirms the original release year, approximately 50-minute runtime, full-length DVD format, principal sections, and Rich Forne's authorship.

Freedom BMX's contemporary release coverage confirms the two-year production, Rich Forne credit, six principal riders plus the later-released Joe Jarvis section, and filming locations across Europe, the United States, and Israel.
